scripts.lint: python -m ruff check . && pnpm -C apps/observatory lint
scripts.typecheck: python -m mypy radiowave scripts && pnpm -C apps/observatory typecheck
scripts.build: python -m compileall -q radiowave scripts && python scripts/export_schemas.py --check && pnpm -C apps/observatory build
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:observatory"
